title: Spock's reverence for the sun
summary: Dan Sherman tells of Spock's reverence for the sun, about early 1990s at First PPD overseas base, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: because he was talking about how we really don't understand the the value of our son

plain: Dan Sherman, a former US Air Force sergeant who says the NSA, the US electronic spy agency, hired him to communicate with aliens, tells of the early 1990s at an overseas base where he served. He says a being or contact he calls Spock talked to him about how humans do not really understand the value of our sun. He tells it, as in his book Above Black, as a glimpse of the outlook of those he says he spoke with.
